name: Video Embed Field - Box.com provider
description: Adds a Video Embed Field provider that renders Box.com shared videos in an iframe.
project_description:
An integration for box.com hosted videos into Video Embed Field. This module adds a new provider to Video Embed Field, using Box Embed framework.

 How to use 
 
 Install video_embed_box. (You will need to have video_embed_field also installed.) 
 Create or reuse a Video Embed field, and enable Box as allowed provider. 
 Add content to that field using a link to the video in box, with the format https://{custom_domain}.app.box.com(/embed)/s/{video id}. For example: https://myboxstuff.app.box.com/s/0hzitvez8whmhoohf91patb21uj8de4j
